card.name: Hasaposerviko
card.tagline: The fast 2/4 'Serbian butcher's dance' form of hasapiko.
card.profile: The fast version of the hasapiko, in 2/4 meter, also called grigoro hasapiko ('fast hasapiko'); the name references Serbian and other Balkan influences. A line/open-circle dance with hands on shoulders, easier and quicker than the slow hasapiko, with changing steps - an expanded, transformed motif of the hasapiko. Accompanied by bouzouki-led ensembles and common in rebetiko/laiko; it forms the fast climactic section of the sirtaki sequence and of many taverna dance sets (English Wikipedia: Hasapiko; Dance Museum).
card.insight: Hasaposerviko is treated within the Hasapiko article on English Wikipedia rather than as a standalone topic; sources describe it as the fast (2/4) hasapiko expanded with Balkan/Eastern-European traits (Leontis, 'Culture and Customs of Greece'; Dance Museum).
